title: M. bovis as a zoonotic MTBC name
dek: Wikipedia's M. bovis page is the dairy/wildlife/BCG parent. Intrinsic PZA-R is a pncA fact, not a surprise MDR.
story: Mycobacterium bovis is the animal-adapted MTBC member Wikipedia associates with cattle, unpasteurised dairy, and wildlife reservoirs. In humans it still makes TB disease — often extrapulmonary — and it still lights MTBC NAATs.

The laboratory punchline is intrinsic pyrazinamide resistance from a characteristic pncA allele. Calling that 'acquired MDR' contaminates surveillance. BCG is a passaged bovis derivative; not every bovis is BCG.
Pasteurisation and slaughter schemes are why many high-income pulmonary services rarely see it. When they do, it is often a missed species call on an MTBC-positive bottle.
deepTitle: What the species page should hand to existing plates
deep: RD9 deletion plus bovis SNPs name the ecotype; the clinic MTBC plate already walks that barcode.
BCG additional RD losses (RD1 and strain-specific RDs) are the vaccine plate, not this one.
M. caprae is a close animal-adapted neighbour; do not merge them in a report just because both are 'bovine'.
Treatment backbones still come from WHO, with PZA omitted because it is inactive — not because Wikipedia said so.

visual.caption: From a bovine reservoir to an MTBC-positive human specimen. The fork is species versus BCG versus Mtb sensu stricto — not 'NAAT failed'.

example.title: Cheese and a PZA-R flag
example.setup: Pulmonary-plus-lymph-node disease, MTB detected, RIF not detected, pncA bovis allele, farm exposure.

steps.title: Do not start a PZA-containing DS-TB narrative as if this were katG MDR
steps.body: Intrinsic PZA-R is the species, not treatment-emergent resistance.

steps.title: Ask dairy/wildlife
steps.body: The Wikipedia zoonosis story is the epidemiologic hint; the barcode is the proof.

steps.title: Keep RIF-S meaning
steps.body: RIF-S bovis disease is still TB disease; it is not NTM.

example.takeaway: Bovis is MTBC with a built-in PZA answer.

check.prompt: Why is M. bovis typically pyrazinamide-resistant?
choices: Because Wikipedia lists it as NTM
Because of a characteristic pncA allele that prevents PZA activation
Because rpoB S450L is universal in bovis
Because BCG vaccination induces PZA resistance in the host
check.answer: Because of a characteristic pncA allele that prevents PZA activation
check.why: Intrinsic pncA, not acquired MDR theatre.

whyWrong.Because BCG vaccination induces PZA resi: Host vaccination does not rewrite pncA.
